measures.name: stock share1
measures.expression:
SUM(REP_SSR_SAG[VALUE])/
CALCULATE(SUM(REP_SSR_SAG[VALUE]),ALLEXCEPT('LINK TABLE','LINK TABLE'[DEPARTMENT],'LINK TABLE'[SECTION],'LINK TABLE'[CATEGORY_NAME],'LINK TABLE'[SUPPLIER],'LINK TABLE'[BRAND_NAME],'LINK TABLE'[LOC_CODE]),ALL(REP_SSR_SAG[NEW AGE]))

measures.name: stock share 2
measures.expression:
SWITCH(TRUE(),
(SELECTEDVALUE(REP_SSR_SAG[NEW AGE])="0-03 MONTHS" )=TRUE(), (CALCULATE(SUM(REP_SSR_SAG[VALUE]),REP_SSR_SAG[NEW AGE] = "0-03 MONTHS")/CALCULATE(SUM(REP_SSR_SAG[VALUE]),ALL(REP_SSR_SAG[NEW AGE]))),
(SELECTEDVALUE(REP_SSR_SAG[NEW AGE])="03-06 MONTHS")=TRUE(), (CALCULATE(SUM(REP_SSR_SAG[VALUE]),REP_SSR_SAG[NEW AGE]="03-06 MONTHS")/CALCULATE(SUM(REP_SSR_SAG[VALUE]),ALL(REP_SSR_SAG[NEW AGE]))),
(SELECTEDVALUE(REP_SSR_SAG[NEW AGE])="06-09 MONTHS")=TRUE(), (CALCULATE(SUM(REP_SSR_SAG[VALUE]),REP_SSR_SAG[NEW AGE]="06-09 MONTHS")/CALCULATE(SUM(REP_SSR_SAG[VALUE]),ALL(REP_SSR_SAG[NEW AGE]))),
(SELECTEDVALUE(REP_SSR_SAG[NEW AGE])="09-12 MONTHS")=TRUE(), (CALCULATE(SUM(REP_SSR_SAG[VALUE]),REP_SSR_SAG[NEW AGE]="09-12 MONTHS")/CALCULATE(SUM(REP_SSR_SAG[VALUE]),ALL(REP_SSR_SAG[NEW AGE]))),
(SELECTEDVALUE(REP_SSR_SAG[NEW AGE])="12-24 MONTHS")=TRUE(), (CALCULATE(SUM(REP_SSR_SAG[VALUE]),REP_SSR_SAG[NEW AGE]="12-24 MONTHS")/CALCULATE(SUM(REP_SSR_SAG[VALUE]),ALL(REP_SSR_SAG[NEW AGE]))),
(SELECTEDVALUE(REP_SSR_SAG[NEW AGE])="24+ MONTHS")=TRUE(), (CALCULATE(SUM(REP_SSR_SAG[VALUE]),REP_SSR_SAG[NEW AGE]="24+ MONTHS")/CALCULATE(SUM(REP_SSR_SAG[VALUE]),ALL(REP_SSR_SAG[NEW AGE]))),
(SELECTEDVALUE(REP_SSR_SAG[NEW AGE])="CANNOT BE DETERMINED")=TRUE(), (CALCULATE(SUM(REP_SSR_SAG[VALUE]),REP_SSR_SAG[NEW AGE]="CANNOT BE DETERMINED")/CALCULATE(SUM(REP_SSR_SAG[VALUE]),ALL(REP_SSR_SAG[NEW AGE])))
)+0

measures.name: measure 3
AGED STOCK LABEL
measures.expression:
VAR val = SUM(REP_SSR_SAG[agingstock])
RETURN
SWITCH(
    TRUE(),
    val >= 1000000, FORMAT(val / 1000000, "0.0") & "M",
    val >= 1000, FORMAT(val / 1000, "0.0") & "K",
    FORMAT(val, "0")
)
